teaser.en: Another 'forest lime': a glossy, aromatic-leaved tree that Digo people link to the lime by sight and smell.
teaser.sw: 'Mdimu wa msituni' mwingine: mti wenye majani yanayong'aa na yenye harufu, ambao Wadigo huuhusisha na mdimu kwa sura na harufu.

summary.en: This mdimu tsaka is a small forest tree with glossy, aromatic leaves and a little milky sap. Digo people give it the same name as Hunteria zeylanica: the forest form of the lime.
summary.sw: Mdimu tsaka huu ni mti mdogo wa msituni wenye majani yanayong'aa, yenye harufu nzuri, na utomvu kidogo kama maziwa. Wadigo huupa jina lile lile la *Hunteria zeylanica*: aina ya msituni ya mdimu.

about.en: This *mdimu tsaka* is a shrub or small tree with smooth bark and glossy, leathery leaves. Held up to the light, the leaves show tiny translucent dots, and they are aromatic. The small greenish-yellow flowers grow in clusters, and male and female flowers are on separate plants. The fruit is a three-lobed capsule. When cut, the plant gives a little milky sap. Digo people identify it by the look and smell of its leaves.
about.sw: *Mdimu tsaka* huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye gome laini na majani yanayong'aa, magumu kama ngozi. Ukiyainua kuelekea mwangaza, majani huonyesha vitone vidogo sana vinavyopitisha mwanga, na yana harufu nzuri. Maua madogo ya rangi ya kijani-manjano huota katika vishada, na maua ya kiume na ya kike huwa kwenye mimea tofauti. Tunda ni kibumba chenye pande tatu. Ukikatwa, mmea hutoa utomvu kidogo kama maziwa. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura na harufu ya majani yake.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest and thicket.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya pwani na vichaka.

uses.en: Pakia records that its latex has no known use.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kwamba utomvu wake hauna matumizi yanayojulikana.

culture.en: Pakia gives *Suregada zanzibariensis* with *Hunteria zeylanica* as plants whose *maziya*, 'milk', has no known use. Its glossy, scented leaves explain why it is thought of as a forest relative of the lime.
culture.sw: Pakia anatoa *Suregada zanzibariensis* pamoja na *Hunteria zeylanica* kama mimea ambayo *maziya*, 'maziwa', yake hayana matumizi yanayojulikana. Majani yake yanayong'aa na yenye harufu yanaeleza kwa nini unadhaniwa kuwa jamaa wa msituni wa mdimu.

names.en: Digo: *mdimu tsaka*, 'lime plant in the forest'. Pakia gives this name, with its meaning, for both *Suregada zanzibariensis* and *Hunteria zeylanica*. Two unrelated forest trees with glossy, citrus-like leaves therefore share it. *Chidimu tsaka* (*Toddaliopsis*), the 'small forest lime', is a true member of the citrus family. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdimu tsaka*, 'mdimu wa msituni'. Pakia anatoa jina hili, pamoja na maana yake, kwa *Suregada zanzibariensis* na *Hunteria zeylanica*. Kwa hiyo miti miwili ya msituni isiyo na uhusiano, yenye majani yanayong'aa kama ya michungwa, inashiriki jina hili. *Chidimu tsaka* (*Toddaliopsis*), 'mdimu mdogo wa msituni', ni mwanafamilia halisi wa familia ya michungwa. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Hunteria, which shares the name mdimu tsaka

reason.sw: Mdimu, ambao jina lake limetokana nao

reason.sw: Alchornea, kichaka kingine cha msituni cha familia ya mibono

definition.en: The harmless milky latex of this plant.
definition.sw: Utomvu wa mmea huu, kama maziwa na usio na madhara.
